tagline: Master the wires before you master the walls.
description: A 12-week guided path into networking fundamentals and network security. Built for beginners who want to understand how data moves — and how attackers intercept it.
outcome: Solid networking fundamentals, hands-on packet analysis experience, and readiness for SOC / network security roles.

phases.title: Phase 1 — Networking Foundations
phases.subtitle: Weeks 1–4 · Learn how networks actually work

items.title: OSI & TCP/IP Models
items.detail: Understand the 7 layers and how real traffic maps to them.

items.title: IP Addressing & Subnetting
items.detail: IPv4/IPv6, subnet masks, CIDR notation, and why they matter for security.

items.title: Core Protocols: DNS, DHCP, HTTP/S
items.detail: How name resolution, address assignment, and web traffic work under the hood.

items.title: Mini Project: Build a Home Lab Network
items.detail: Set up a virtual router, switch, and two hosts using GNS3 or Packet Tracer.

phases.title: Phase 2 — Network Security Core
phases.subtitle: Weeks 5–8 · Learn how attackers exploit the network layer

items.title: Firewalls & Network Segmentation
items.detail: How firewalls filter traffic and why segmentation limits breach impact.

items.title: Packet Analysis with Wireshark
items.detail: Capture and inspect live traffic to spot anomalies and plaintext leaks.

items.title: VPNs & Encrypted Tunnels
items.detail: IPSec vs SSL VPNs, and why encryption in transit matters.

items.title: Mini Project: Detect an Attack in a PCAP
items.detail: Analyze a provided packet capture to find a simulated port scan or MITM attempt.

phases.title: Phase 3 — Network Security Career
phases.subtitle: Weeks 9–12 · Get certified and get hired

items.title: Certification Prep
items.detail: Study for CompTIA Network+ or CompTIA Security+.

items.title: Intrusion Detection Systems
items.detail: Learn Snort or Suricata basics for detecting malicious traffic patterns.

items.title: Practice Network CTF Rooms
items.detail: Hands-on rooms focused on network enumeration and exploitation.

items.title: Build a Network Security Portfolio
items.detail: Two writeups — a PCAP investigation and a segmented lab network design.
